scope_freeze: Owner must read the complete task packet, source gap rows, dependencies, current task notes, and prior review findings before editing.
A reopened owner must re-audit every packet criterion; fixing only the latest reviewer example is not a valid handoff.
Newly discovered requirements must be classified as an omitted requirement, regression, or genuinely new follow-up and recorded before implementation.
owner_pre_handoff: All packet criteria are marked PASS or evidence-backed NOT_APPLICABLE; UNKNOWN is not handoff-ready.
Implementation and evidence are committed on the task branch based on current origin/dev.
Focused, negative/mutation, integration, and touched-scope quality gates pass on the exact tested source revision.
Evidence records exact source/tree SHA, commands, runner versions, start/end timestamps, exit codes, artifact hashes, and environment identity.
No unrelated generated files, stale artifacts, fixtures, mocks, synthetic data, or self-authored approvals are included as completion evidence.
review: Reviewer must be different from owner and independently inspect the exact pushed head in a clean checkout.
Reviewer replays acceptance and at least one negative/mutation path; owner-reported green output alone is insufficient.
Any source/config/test change after approval invalidates the approval and requires exact-head re-review.
pr_merge_closeout: Open or refresh one task-scoped PR only after the complete local batch is handoff-ready.
Required CI must pass on the exact PR head before merge to dev.
Only the owner closes the task after merge SHA and required artifacts are archived and read back.
deployment: No task may deploy production merely because its focused tests pass.
Only ODP-PLAN-LIVE-STAGING-PROOF-001 may perform the planned staging/live deployment workflow, and only after every declared dependency is merged and verified.
ODP-PLAN-FINAL-GATE-AUDIT-001 and Human/Ops approval remain mandatory for any GO release claim.
human_gate: Human-gate tasks are not dispatchable to an AI worker as an approver.
AI may prepare a handoff template and validate a returned receipt, but may not author the approval, source data, UAT result, legal decision, or live operational fact.
Missing, expired, unverifiable, mismatched, or repository-local self-attested receipts fail closed.
